messages:
maria: Quick design review: batch vectors export modal — low cert about 'Select' labels and sample labeling. Dropping Figma + screenshots: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/batch-vectors-export — notes below josh: Link looks good. main concern? maria: Current CTA 'Export selection' is ambiguous. If user checked 'Select 100 of 1,200', they might expect page-only. Need clearer copy: 'Export selected vectors (100 of 1,200)'. anita: Agree. Suggest: 'Export 100 selected vectors' for primary CTA; secondary: 'Export all 1,200 vectors (CSV)' to make scope explicit. kevin: From impl side: exporting all should warn about size. We can make it an async job + notification. Also header mapping question: include 'embedding_dim' vs 'vector_length' — which should we pick for CSV header? priya: Accessibility: screen reader should announce selection context and number. Propose aria-live for selection changes and descriptive aria-label on the master checkbox: `Select 100 of 1,200 vectors`. Also ensure the modal traps focus and returns focus to the trigger. maria: Priya can you drop exact aria snippet? priya: Yes — example: ```html
100 vectors selected
``` oliver: :thumbsup: Also keyboard flow: when modal opens, focus should move to the first interactive element (search input) not the heading. Tab order needs validation. josh: Note: preview sampler control (sample size dropdown) is hidden on narrow viewports. Maybe collapse it into a 'Preview' accordion to save space and keep controls discoverable. maria: Good call. Also the relevance table density feels too sparse compared to other consoles — rows are taller, which increases vertical scroll. Can we tighten row padding and move inline explainability toggle into the table header? kevin: Tightening rows will reduce room for long labels; we can ellipsize with a tooltip for full text. Prefer putting the explainability toggle in header to avoid per-row clutter. anita: Copy tweak for relevance score column: change 'Relevance' -> 'Relevance (model)' to clarify source. Also suggest microcopy for the sampler tooltip: 'Random sample of vectors shown for preview only — export respects full selection.' maria: Final ask: can design produce a11y copy + 2 microcopy variants? I'll update Figma and tag everyone. @anita @priya anita: I'll draft 3 microcopy options and post by EOD. priya: I'll add ARIA notes and keyboard flow doc tomorrow morning. kevin: I'll add export job warning and header mapping options to the ticket (size estimates included). maria: Thanks — fixing the visual nits in Figma now and will re-upload for another quick pass.
